changed: When another device runs a newer version of the app and shares records with details this version doesn't sync yet, Device Sync now says so in the "update the app on this device" notice, with a count of each kind of record waiting (for example "2 programs, 1 setting"). Previously those records were listed in the general "records were skipped" notice alongside records skipped for unrelated reasons, which told you to check your other devices instead.

added: A record blob whose body carries a field this build does not classify shareable — unknown, or known but private — throws SyncNewerFieldException (a FormatException) and is reported as SyncReportCode.newerRecordFields; SyncApplyEngine.applyJson reports it, and a newer envelope, by their own codes.
